name: Habo
tagline: Build good habits with a private, simple tracker
description:
Habo helps you build better habits without giving up your privacy. Everything you track is end-to-end encrypted, so only you can see your data, even when it syncs between your phone and other devices.

It's simple and minimal by design, with support for self-hosting your own sync server if you want full control. Habo works on both Android and iOS.
